name: How does Frasheski Construction handle punch list communication with clients?

mainEntity.name: How does Frasheski Construction handle punch list communication with clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction prioritizes clear and consistent communication throughout the punch list process. We typically schedule a final walk-through with the client to jointly create and review the punch list, ensuring all identified items are documented and understood. Following this, we provide regular updates on the progress of punch list item completion. This proactive communication ensures transparency and allows clients to track progress effectively, minimizing surprises and ensuring the final outcome meets their expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction conducts a joint walk-through to create the punch list, then provides regular updates on item completion to ensure transparency.
